description: Permanent sponsorship gating corpus (DECISION_LOG 012d041, v0.1 final; earlier rounds 13f2ec9, bc50be7, 9186ad2, 4c34779). Each text is read as a job posting (description, optional title and locations; a London job unless `jobCountries` says otherwise) without company data. Posting text never yields a verdict: any explicit_yes / explicit_no fails. `form: structured` entries have a structured line whose stated value (`statement`) must be extracted as `sponsorship_stated` (a wrong value fails, a miss lowers recall). `flags` must be present, `noFlags` absent; `advisoryFlags` only feed a coverage metric. Each re-review adds its out-of-sample set.
